title: Track pronoun referents
subtitle: Do not guess what αὐτός or οὗτος points to.
overview: Pronouns can refer to a noun, a person already in view, or an entire preceding idea. Make an explicit referent note before translating.
Agreement eliminates some options, while paragraph logic chooses among the remaining ones.

sections.title: Reference clues
rows: he / she / it; self, depending on position

items.grc: εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ἀκολούθει μοι.
ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ ἐν ὑμῖν ᾖ.
items.en: I have spoken these things to you so that my joy may be in you.
